citations.title: Filtering and reducing AI agent telemetry with the OpenTelemetry Collector
citations.summary: AI coding agent telemetry generates a large volume of OpenTelemetry native data that is expensive to store and difficult to interpret.
citations.why: Managing and understanding this telemetry data is a challenge for engineers due to its volume and complexity.

citations.title: Before you evaluate an AI SRE, give your existing agent context
citations.summary: Existing coding agents used by engineers can investigate a Kubernetes cluster. These agents often lack the necessary context to function as an AI SRE.
citations.why: Leveraging and providing context to existing coding agents could be a foundational step before evaluating new AI SRE products.

citations.title: How AI workloads are reshaping Kubernetes autoscaling
citations.summary: Kubernetes has historically managed containerized software using two control loops that operated largely independently. AI workloads are now influencing how Kubernetes autoscaling functions.
citations.why: The evolving interaction between Kubernetes control loops due to AI workloads impacts resource management and efficiency for data and AI infrastructure.

citations.title: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE in PHP
citations.summary: AI identified a critical Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability in PHP, termed PHP2Shell. This flaw allows arbitrary code execution on affected PHP installations.
citations.why: This vulnerability could impact data and AI systems built on or interacting with PHP environments, necessitating immediate security review and patching.

citations.title: Your Agent Runs in a Docker Sandbox. Now It Can Join a Team.
citations.summary: AI agents can run in Docker Sandboxes using BAND AI. This allows for connecting isolated agents, collaborating across environments, and secure access management.
citations.why: This enables structured collaboration and secure management of AI agents deployed in isolated Docker environments, which is critical for enterprise AI deployments.
